description: Source code for Intel-specific GPIO driver implementation in Zephyr RTOS, including register definitions, configuration, and API functions for time-aware GPIO operations.

methods.name: regs
methods.description: Returns the memory-mapped register base address for the device.

methods.name: tgpio_intel_get_time
methods.description: Retrieves the current time from the hardware timer.

methods.name: tgpio_intel_periodic_output
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin for periodic output with start time and interval.

methods.name: tgpio_intel_config_external_timestamp
methods.description: Configures external timestamp input with specified polarity.

methods.name: tgpio_intel_read_ts_ec
methods.description: Reads timestamp and event count for a specific pin.

methods.name: tgpio_init
methods.description: Initializes the device, mapping its register base.
